name: @agro-ai/load-tests
description: k6 load & stress tests for the AGRO AI FastAPI backend with Excel report generation

scripts.report: node generate-report.js --input reports/baseline-result.json --output reports/load-test-report.xlsx --name "AGRO AI Baseline"
scripts.report:stress: node generate-report.js --input reports/stress-result.json --output reports/stress-report.xlsx --name "AGRO AI Stress"
scripts.run:all: npm run baseline && npm run report
scripts.run:stress:report: npm run stress && npm run report:stress

author: AGRO AI Engineering
